from greeting import greet
from unittest.mock import patch
cases = ['', 'Ada', ' ', '  Ada  ', '\t\n', 'A B', '你好🌍', 'e\u0301', '\0']
for name in cases:
    expected = 'Hello, ' + ('world' if name == '' else name) + '!'
    assert greet(name) == expected, repr(name)
with patch('greeting.greeting_prefix', side_effect=['Good day', 'Hola']) as provider:
    assert greet('A') == 'Good day, A!'
    assert greet('') == 'Hola, world!'
    assert provider.call_count == 2
print('9 boundary cases and 2 dynamic-prefix assertions passed')
